verses.1: And they showed me a river of living water, as bright as a crystal. It flowed from the throne of God and the bull.
verses.2: In the middle of her field; and along the river, from both sides, she produces fruit from living trees. Every month, she gives away one fruit from each tree. The leaves of these trees are used for healing purposes among the people.
verses.3: And everything that was given as a sacrifice will no longer be there. The throne of God and that of the bull will also be there. And His slaves will worship Him.
verses.4: And their faces see his face, and their names are written on their foreheads.
verses.5: And night will no longer exist. There will be no need for the light of lamps or the brightness of the sun. For the Lord God will shine upon them, and they will reign forever.
verses.6: And he said to me, “These are faithful and true words. And the Lord, the God of the prophets, has sent His angel to show His servants what they must do.”
verses.7: And I will come quickly. It is good to listen to the words of prophecy in this book.
verses.8: I, John, who was listening to and watching all these things. When I heard and saw them, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel who showed me these things.
verses.9: And he said to me, “Do not be my companion. I am like one of your brothers among the prophets, and like those who keep the words of this book. Worship only God.”
verses.10: And he said to me, “Do not seal up the words of this prophecy in this book. For time is near.”
verses.11: He will still be treated unfairly; the wicked will continue to be treated unjustly. The just will still carry out justice. And the holy will still be honored as holy.
verses.12: I’m coming quickly now. My salary will be given to each person along with the work that they have done.
verses.13: I am the Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end.
verses.14: May those who wash their clothes be blessed, so that their authority may be established over the wood of life, and they may enter the city through its gates.
verses.15: Outside, there are prostitutes, thieves, murderers, idolaters, and all those who commit fraud and deceit.
verses.16: I, Jesus, have sent my angel to bear witness to these things to you in the churches. I am David’s lineage; I am the bright shining star among the stars.
verses.17: And the wind and the nymphs say, “Come.” And he who hears, says, “Come.” And he who is thirsty, will come too. He who wants to receive free water as a gift.
verses.18: I testify that everyone who hears the words of this book of prophecy will be struck by God with the punishments written in it. If anyone does anything against these words, then God will strike him with those punishments.
verses.19: And if anyone were to ignore the words of this prophecy, then God will take away his share from the “tree of life” and from the “holy city” mentioned in this book.
verses.20: The witnesses say this: “Naï, I will hurry. Amen, come, Lord Jesus.”
verses.21: The grace of the Lord Jesus above all else.
